text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Mejiro Palmer and Mejiro McQueen were 
defeated. However, for the sake of the 
Mejiro family, Mejiro McQueen was already 
looking ahead to what's next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Palmer was hesitating. 
She claimed it was for her own freedom, 
but was this truly something to be proud 
of? Or was it just pure selfishness?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal is the spring Grand Prix, 
the Takarazuka Kinen. In a festival-like 
race that fires up fans and runners alike, 
can Mejiro Palmer rediscover her true 
self?
